name: Mae Moh Half Marathon
short_description: The Mae Moh Half Marathon is a 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km event held in Mae Moh, Lampang, Thailand on October 25, 2026.
ai_summary: The Mae Moh Half Marathon is a race organized by the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT), scheduled for October 25, 2026, in Mae Moh, Lampang, Thailand.
